description: Unit test class for SendClaimMessage, testing immutability, equality, serialization, deserialization, and various constructor behaviors within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.messages package.

classes.name: SendClaimMessageTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for asserting behavior and correctness of SendClaimMessage and related components.

methods.name: assertImmutability
